answer: Think of the economy as a harbor: each agent moors at a jetty only after locking a small stake in a shared vault, and the stake stays time-locked, released slowly as the agent completes verified work. A knoll of fake identities gains nothing, because every clone must fund its own vault deposit and wait out the same lockup, while misbehavior slashes the deposit of the guilty identity alone. Forging a thousand accounts then costs a thousand stakes and a thousand waiting periods, so honest agents with a single funded history always outcompete a Sybil swarm.
